blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: Port Moody real estate market stats

faq.a: Yes. Anmore is the Village of Anmore, a village municipality in Metro Vancouver with its own council, bylaws and municipal office at 2697 Sunnyside Road; its board statistics, however, are grouped inside the Port Moody SnapStats community (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats).

Two SD43 schools are physically located in the village: Anmore Elementary (30 Elementary Rd, Anmore) and Eagle Mountain Middle School (110 Dogwood Dr, Anmore), checked against the BC Ministry K-12 schools file used by this program. Catchment for a specific home is address-based and must be confirmed in the SD43 locator — no Anmore locator run is on record in this program (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Does Anmore have a SkyTrain station?
faq.a: No. Anmore has no SkyTrain station; the Millennium Line stations shown on TransLink's regional connections diagram nearest the village are Moody Centre and Inlet Centre, both in the neighbouring City of Port Moody.

faq.q: How active is the Anmore market?
faq.a: Thin and slow-turning in the most recent month in the data: the Anmore sub-area showed 28 detached listings with 0 solds in September 2026, and no Condos & Townhomes listings at all — inside a Port Moody community that recorded 15 detached and 29 attached solds the same month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats).
